parts.text: Iron from the Blast Furnace is impure. It contains about 5% of impurities, mainly carbon, sulfur, silicon and phosphorus, which have to be removed when this iron is converted into steel.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Mild steel is the most common form of steel. Mild steel contains a maximum of 0.3% of carbon. High carbon steel contains 2% of carbon. It is less malleable and much harder than mild steel.
